command: cd /workspace; echo "API=$MCPJAM_API_URL"; for p in "" /usage /credits /billing /v1/usage /v1/credits; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -m 10 -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL$p" | head -c 600; done; echo "== docs"; curl -s -m 10 -L https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 800

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -c 4000; echo ======; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cli/|credit|billing" | cut -c1-120 | head -30; which mcpjam npx

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md | head -c 2500; echo =====; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md | head -c 1500; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "api-reference/(evals|eval-runs)/" | cut -c1-110

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" $B/organizations | tee orgs.json; echo; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" $B/projects | head -c 800; echo; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites | head -c 800

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" $B/organizations/org_fixture/spend-budget; echo; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture/launch-plan; echo; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture/disclosure; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "pre-run disclosure|create-an-eval-run-async" | cut -c1-200

cd /workspace; cat > run_eval.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Repeatable: rerun suite_fixture, poll to verdict. Output in /workspace/run_*.json
H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; P=project_fixture
curl -s -m 20 -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-mcpjam-launcher: workspace-script" \
  -d '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture"}' $B/projects/$P/eval-runs | tee run_create.json; echo
RID=$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('run_create.json')).get('runId',''))")
[ -z "$RID" ] && exit 2
for i in $(seq 1 10); do curl -s -H "$H" $B/projects/$P/eval-runs/$RID > run_status.json; cat run_status.json; echo; grep -qE '"status": ?"(running|queued|pending)"' run_status.json || break; sleep 5; done
EOF
chmod +x run_eval.sh; ./run_eval.sh

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md | grep -iB2 -A8 -E "PLATFORM_FEE|credits" | head -50; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "billing|credits|pricing|plans" | cut -c1-160
